name: @sos-2/sandbox
description: SOS 2.0 Bounded Execution Environments (Work Order P8): the sandbox contract every P8 reference body executes within — filesystem scope (workspace/sandboxed-tree/none; out-of-scope access is a typed denial), network egress policy (none/allowlist; a call to a denied host is a typed denial — no ambient network anywhere in this package), secrets isolation (injected credentials live ONLY inside the sandbox closure; values are never echoed, logged or serialized — only NAMES are ever declared, mirroring the P3/P5 environment-contract discipline), and resource envelopes as injected limits (deterministic operation budgets — file writes/bytes, shell commands, network calls, credential resolutions — the in-process realization of cpu/memory/time budgets; a budget overrun is a typed denial). Boundary violations are TYPED DENIALS (SandboxResult OK | DENIED with a typed SandboxDenial) — never silent, never a crash. The reference implementation (createLocalSandbox) is a deterministic, in-process, offline-testable bounded environment whose describe() answers the merged P5 BoundedEnvironmentDescription (consumed vocabulary — filesystem scope, network egress policy, isolation level, limits, environment variable NAMES only). Real provider sandboxes (containers/VMs) attach later behind the same contract without change.
